conbody.p: If Smart Cruise Control is temporarily canceled automatically, the warning message will appear on the cluster, and an audible warning will sound to warn the driver.
Smart Cruise Control will be temporarily canceled automatically when:

li.p: Your driving speed is above 180 km/h (110 mph)
The vehicle is stopped for a certain period of time
The accelerator pedal is continuously depressed for a certain period of time
The conditions for the Smart Cruise Control to operate is not satisfied
When the gear position is in N (Neutral), R (Reverse), P (Parking) or in a condition where shifting is not possible
When the Electronic Stability Control (ESC) system or the ABS system is turned off
When the Power down indicator light is illuminated

note.p: If Smart Cruise Control is temporarily canceled while the vehicle is at a standstill with the function activated, EPB (Electronic Parking Brake) maybe applied.

When Smart Cruise Control is temporarily canceled, distance with the front vehicle will not be maintained. Always have your eyes on the road while driving, and if necessary, depress the brake pedal to reduce your driving speed in order to maintain a safe distance.
